title: Integrating Machine Learning and Knowledge Graphs for Explainable Soil Organic Carbon Assessment in Agroforestry Systems
abstract: This work combines machine learning with knowledge graph representations to improve explainable assessment of soil organic carbon in agroforestry systems.

title: Bridging Organisational Data Silos through Multi-Agent Generative Systems and Integrated Relational Governance
abstract: This study explores multi-agent generative approaches for unifying siloed organisational data through relational governance and interpretable cross-system integration.

title: ATMAS: Design, Implementation, and Evaluation of an Automated Test Management and Asset Scheduling System for a University Research Engineering Laboratory
abstract: ATMAS presents an automated platform for test management and asset scheduling, replacing spreadsheet-driven workflows with a traceable and operationally efficient system.
